description: Fetch current documentation and code examples for a library using its Context7-compatible library ID.

context7CompatibleLibraryID.description: Context7-compatible library ID to fetch documentation for, as returned by resolve-library-id, for example "/vercel/next.js".

tokens.description: Optional maximum number of documentation tokens to return; defaults to 10000 and values below 10000 are raised to 10000.

topic.description: Optional topic to focus the returned documentation on, for example "routing".

name: get-library-docs
